title: Vintage Le Creuset Oval Cast Iron Dish – Orange – Made in France – Rare Piece
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset oval cast iron dish, made in France, in the iconic orange enamel color.
A less common model with a pouring spout, both practical and very decorative.
✔️ Le Creuset – Made in France (marking worn / not clearly visible due to age)
✔️ Oval shape with pouring spout (rare feature)
✔️ Classic vintage orange gradient enamel
✔️ Size marking 34 on the base
📏 Approximate dimensions:
Length (handle to handle): ~36–37 cm
Width: ~22–23 cm
✔️ Condition: good vintage condition
Clean interior with light signs of use
Enamel in nice condition overall
Exterior shows normal wear for its age
Brand inscription is faded, not visible (common for vintage pieces)
💡 Suitable for all stovetops + oven
💡 Perfect for gratins, fish, roasted vegetables or serving
